acceptance_criteria: A discovery run that fails against an unreachable or refusing endpoint records a reason class that names the failure, and outcome_summary no longer reads failure_reason_class:FAILED.
A job row in FAILED carries a non-empty outcome, a non-empty terminal_reason and a finished_at.
A step attempt row carries output_bytes and output_lines that came from the step, and matched_expectation is a boolean rather than NULL wherever the expectation was evaluated.
Named tests hold each of the three joins above and fail if a constant is reintroduced.
The full suite and the repository privacy gate pass.

baseline.authority: docs/design/UI2_0_C2_JOB_EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md (FROZEN) -- the jobs table row in section 2 requires `outcome`, `terminal_reason`, `finished_at` to be `set once, on the single legal transition into a terminal state`, and section 3s state table defines FAILED as `a definite, non-ambiguous failure ... where the worker can prove no operational-write steps outcome is ambiguous`.

baseline.observed: Standing the product up on HOST-A on 2026-09-15, a Check Point discovery run failed. Finding out why required querying PostgreSQL by hand, and the answer was not there either.
baseline.what_exists:
Observed rows, redacted:

  discovery_run: vendor=check_point state=FAILED
    outcome_summary = { "failure_reason_class:FAILED": 1 }

  jobs: job_type=cp_discovery_enumerate state=FAILED
    outcome         = (empty)
    terminal_reason = (empty)
    finished_at     = (empty)
    lease_worker_id = worker-<uuid>   (the worker did lease and run it)

  job_step_attempt: step_kind=DISCOVERY_ENUMERATE_READ
    outcome             = EXPECTATION_UNMET
    matched_expectation = NULL
    output_bytes        = 0
    output_lines        = 0

The three defects, quoted from source:

1. ui2/worker/src/main/java/.../discovery/DiscoveryJobExecutor.java:159 and :174
     case ManagementPlaneEnumerationResult.Failed failed -> EnumerationOutcome.failed("FAILED");
     case PanoramaEnumerationResult.Failed failed -> EnumerationOutcome.failed("FAILED");
   The vendor result carries a Failed value, it is bound to `failed`, and it is
   discarded in favour of the literal string "FAILED". That literal is what
   reaches outcome_summary, which is why the summary is circular.

2. ui2/worker/src/main/java/.../discovery/DiscoveryJobExecutor.java:126
     return new JobOutcome.Failed(outcome.failureReasonClass);
   The reason is produced and returned, and jobs.terminal_reason is still empty
   in the observed row. The chain breaks between this return and the terminal
   write.

3. ui2/worker/src/main/java/.../discovery/DiscoveryJobExecutor.java:117
     attemptRepository.writeOutcome(attemptId, leaseEpoch,
         outcome.succeeded ? "MATCHED" : "EXPECTATION_UNMET", null, 0L, 0L, fingerprintOf(outcome));
   and ui2/job-engine/src/main/java/.../executor/StepExecutor.java:263
     attemptRepository.writeOutcome(attemptId, leaseEpoch, outcome, errorClass, 0L, 0L, ...)
   matched_expectation, output_bytes and output_lines are constants. The zeros
   are not a measurement of a device response; they are literals, and they read
   as measurements to anyone inspecting the row.

The repository signature the writes go through:
  ui2/job-engine/src/main/java/.../stepattempt/JobStepAttemptRepository.java:23
    boolean writeOutcome(String attemptId, long leaseEpoch, String outcome,
                         String errorClass, long outputBytes, long outputLines, ...)

invariants: AGENTS.md raw-evidence law: parse to safe classes and discard the raw response; never persist a raw vendor response to make debugging easier.
AGENTS.md UNKNOWN / fail-closed law: where a failure genuinely cannot be classified, record an explicit unknown class rather than inventing a specific one.
C2 section 3: a terminal state is written once, under the claiming workers lease epoch. Do not add a second write path.
No schema migration in this movement.
report.merge_gate: The worker opens the pull request and does not merge it. Merge is the Product Owner assistants, after verify.passed and a read of the diff.
report.objective: A job that reaches a terminal state records why. C2 requires outcome, terminal_reason and finished_at to be set on the single legal transition into a terminal state; today a FAILED job leaves all three empty, the discovery failure reason class is the literal string FAILED, and every step attempt records constants where its measurements belong.
output_contract: A SESSION CLOSE on the relay as one NEXUS_SESSION_PACKET.

recommended_reasoning.reason: Bounded work inside a frozen contract, with the defective lines already located and quoted. No new architecture and no vendor semantics to establish.

requirements: Read docs/design/UI2_0_C2_JOB_EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md section 2 and section 3 before changing a terminal write.
A reason class is a closed enumeration defined in source, not a string built at the call site. A caller that cannot classify a failure records the class it can prove and nothing more.
No vendor message, device output, address, hostname or credential enters a reason class, a terminal_reason, or a test fixture.
Do not change the meaning of EXPECTATION_UNMET or MATCHED; this movement makes their companions honest, not their vocabulary different.
risks: The reason value may be the easiest place for a vendor error string to leak into the database. The closed-enumeration requirement exists for that reason and is not negotiable.
The terminal write is fenced by lease epoch. A change that writes the reason on a second, unfenced path would break C2 section 3s single-write rule while appearing to work.

in: Carry the vendor failure value in DiscoveryJobExecutor.enumerateCheckPoint and enumeratePaloAlto into the reason class instead of discarding it for the literal "FAILED". The classes must be a closed, named set (for example REFUSED, UNSUPPORTED_VENDOR, and whatever the vendor result actually distinguishes) -- never free text, never a vendor message copied through.

Persist the terminal triple on the transition into a terminal state, so that a FAILED job carries outcome, terminal_reason and finished_at as C2 section 2 requires. Find where JobOutcome.Failed is consumed and why its reason does not reach the row.
Record the step attempts measurements instead of constants: matched_expectation, output_bytes and output_lines must reflect what the step actually saw, at both call sites named in what_exists.

Targeted tests: a failed discovery writes a named reason class, not "FAILED"; a FAILED job row carries a non-empty terminal_reason and a finished_at; a step attempt records a byte count that is not a hardcoded zero.
out: Any new logging framework, log screen, or diagnostics surface. Those are separate movements; this one only makes the existing fields tell the truth.

Retaining or logging a raw vendor response. AGENTS.md raw-evidence law: the reason is a safe class, a counter or a relationship -- never the device output, never a vendor error string copied verbatim.
Changing the job state machine, the lease/fencing model, or any transition in C2 section 3.
The audit screen (B1-8) and the Jobs screen (B1-7).
Any schema migration. The columns already exist; this movement fills them.
